g.text: Cleanroom 0.7.0; real dedicated server and client
Riven height [-128, 384): 32 cubes per column. One host, JFR active, 40 warmup ticks per scenario.
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060/PCIe/SSE2; 1280 x 720, 120 FPS cap, no GUI frames. Descriptive p95/p99; no controlled speedup claim.
